meta.name: Sync documentation vectors from GitHub with Ollama and Qdrant

parameters.content:
## 🛠️ n8n Documentation Vector Sync

**Purpose:** Daily automated ingestion of the official n8n documentation repository (`n8n-io/n8n-docs`) into Qdrant for local RAG retrieval.

**👤 Who It's For:**
DevOps & AI Engineers setting up local RAG pipelines to feed official n8n documentation into local LLMs.

**⚙️ Prerequisites:**
• Host Ollama running `nomic-embed-text`
• Local Qdrant instance on port 6333 (`n8n_docs` collection)

**🚀 Setup & How to Use:**
1. Ensure Qdrant and Ollama credentials are configured.
2. Activate the workflow to run automatically every day at 3:00 AM, or click "Execute Workflow" for an immediate initial sync.

### 1. Check for Changes, Collection Wipe & Tree Fetch

• Check SHA of n8n docs repo and continue only if it has changed
• Wipes existing vectors in `n8n_docs` via Qdrant REST API to prevent point duplication.
• Queries GitHub API for the recursive file tree of the official `n8n-io/n8n-docs` repository.

### 3. Markdown Chunking & Qdrant Ingestion

• Splits raw Markdown pages into logical sections by headings (`#`, `##`, `###`).
• Generates text embeddings via Ollama (`nomic-embed-text`).
• Upserts document chunks and rich metadata directly into Qdrant `n8n_docs` collection.
• Writes new SHA of n8n docs repo to persistent memory

• Filters repository file tree to isolate official Markdown (`.md`) documentation pages.
• Fetches raw Markdown content from GitHub raw endpoints using 10-item batching and retry options to prevent rate limits.
